opening.argument: The material is a conference interview examining a controlled enterprise technology deployment, not an appeal for audience participation, private data, or funds. It identifies a completed proof-of-concept pilot involving a complex business case and explains that the AI was trained on documentation, workflows, policies, processes, and approvals. The system is then described as interacting with customer-service associates "in this controlled environment," supporting contact-center and client-service operations. References to banking, financial services, operating costs, efficiency, and return on investment therefore concern internal evaluation of an AI platform and its operational performance. The visible conference-room interview setting reinforces an educational and technology-demonstration format, with no observed transaction request or promised financial outcome.

citations.quote: I'm Michael Krigsman. I'm here in New York City at IPSoft's Digital Workforce Summit, and I'm speaking with Tom DeCarlo
We actually completed phase one of a proof of concept pilot with a pretty complex business case
We taught Emelia, we trained her with training documentation, workflows, policy and processes, approvals as well, on the best way to do so
she is interacting directly in this controlled environment with our CSAs at a high quality
